result.summary: The food delivery app screen is mostly well-structured, but there are a few minor visual issues related to text truncation and content overflow.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge and its name is truncated abruptly without ellipsis styling context.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontally scrollable cards have consistent padding and add proper ellipsis truncation or partial peek to indicate more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card appears as a plain outline on a dark background, while the pizza card below shows the heart in a filled dark circle, resulting in inconsistent favorite button styling.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button background and style across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card at the bottom is partially cut off by the fold, showing only the top portion of the image with no restaurant name visible.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for scrollable content, but ensure adequate spacing above the bottom navigation bar so partial cards don't appear visually broken.
